question: How many Schedules are there in the Constitution of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**12.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Constitution of India **has **12 schedules, **which are essentially lists or** annexures **that provide additional details about various aspects of the Constitution.
 
• The schedule**s** cover topics such as** languages, forms of oaths, allocation of seats **in the **Rajya Sabha, **and** tribal areas**.
 
• Each schedule is **numbered** and has a specific purpose, such as **Schedule 1** which contains the **names of States **and** Union Territories.**
 
• The schedules can be amended by **Parliament **through a special majority vote, as per** Article 368** of the Constitution.
 
• Option 2, 3, and 4 are** incorrect** as there are more than 9, 10, and 11 schedules respectively in the Constitution of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2**: There are more than 10 schedules in the Constitution of India, therefore this option is **incorrect.**
 
• **Option 3:** There are more than 11 schedules in the Constitution of India, therefore this option is** incorrect.**
 
• **Option 4**: There are more than 9 schedules in the Constitution of India, therefore this option is **incorrect.**
